title: Debate & Information Structure — Review
goal: Bring together clitic left dislocation, concession, polite floor management, reformulation and consecutive clauses in formal debate.
grammar: dislocación clítica, si bien / sin embargo, polite imperfect, reformulation, de tal manera que

items: I can front known direct and indirect objects as topics with matching clitic pronouns.
I can concede a point before answering, take the floor politely in formal register, and reformulate an opponent's claims.
I can close a debate using consecutive clauses and precise argumentation vocabulary.
